name: Gold Dust Exchange
summary: At Goldshire's crossroads, Gold Dust Exchange brings Remy "Two Times" coin for gold dust from kobolds in Elwynn's mines. Travelers gather the dust and trade it to the nervous broker for pay.

sections.title: A Town of Pockets and Picks
sections.body: Goldshire sits where Elwynn Forest's roads meet. Travelers, merchants, and guards pass through town. Remy "Two Times" is a shady broker with a sharp eye for profit. He repeats his words, and instead of hiring mining crews to dig raw minerals, he offers coin to travelers passing through the Lion's Pride Inn for gold dust taken from kobolds in the region.

sections.title: The Kobold Plunder
sections.body: Kobolds have overrun Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire and Jasperlode Mine to the northeast. These rat-like tunnelers chip through the dark for candles and shiny baubles, gathering flecks of unrefined ore in their pouches. Driving them back serves the kingdom. Their gold dust also turns the work into a trade for coin.

sections.title: Shadows Behind the Counter
sections.body: Remy says he pays well for ordinary trade, but each payment carries a warning. When he receives the dust, he gives his helpers a small token for his "associates." Bandits, unpaid stonemasons, and hidden networks are active in Stormwind's shadows. Remy's quiet brokers may have plans for the gold beyond village commerce.

faq.answer: Remy "Two Times" is a shady local broker outside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. He repeats the ends of his sentences, buys precious materials from travelers, and keeps ties with shadowy associates.

faq.q: Where do kobolds get gold dust?
aliases: why do kobolds have gold dust
where does gold dust come from
faq.answer: Kobolds tunnel through Elwynn's mineral veins, including those in Fargodeep and Jasperlode. As they dig through rock for treasure and candle wax, raw gold flakes and dust gather in their pockets and pouches.

faq.q: Where can I find the mines mentioned by Remy?
faq.answer: Kobolds carrying gold dust are found mainly within and around Fargodeep Mine, south of Goldshire, and Jasperlode Mine, northeast near the border toward the Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind allow kobolds to control their mines?
aliases: why did stormwind lose the mines
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and the House of Nobles refusing troops for the outskirts, the Stormwind City Guard is stretched thin. Local garrisons cannot clear the mines, leaving kobolds there while independent travelers fight them.

faq.q: Is gold dust used for blacksmithing or trade?
aliases: what is gold dust used for
faq.answer: The particles in the kobolds' raw gold dust are too fine and impure for ordinary forge work. Brokers like Remy take it as a raw commodity, consolidate it, then refine it through their own private channels.

angles.text: Miners searching Fargodeep and Jasperlode find kobolds clinging to the richest copper veins. Clearing them out is necessary to harvest ore.
As a rogue, you may read Remy's hushed manner and the token from unnamed "associates" as signs of underground syndicates beneath Goldshire's placid surface.
As an Alliance member, you see Elwynn's vital gold and mineral deposits in the hands of feral kobolds rather than royal excavators. The kingdom's military forces are depleted.
